$Comment: The restless graveyard, the dungeon the Gravekeeper opens on a full moon outside Hallow's Eve: the
Headless Horseman's graveyard on a night the dead will not stay down, run as an endless wave run. Every
area of a copy pastes SeasonsOfOrbis/Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Graveyard.prefab.json (the Horseman's
night graveyard with the run's entity, the Voidtaken Horseman's spawn marker and a way-out pad in its
entrance room; tools/arena_markers.py writes it), so every fresh paste stages a fresh run. EntryOffset
lands an arriving party one block up, standing on the entrance room's floor, and EntryYaw 180 turns them
to face south, into the graveyard. IntroCamera plays the Horseman's graveyard's own sweep
(Hallows_Eve_Graveyard_Intro), since both share one layout.
Season keeps it closed except on a full moon outside Hallow's Eve (Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Moon); on
Hallow's Eve the Horseman's own graveyards stand instead. Share: one party to an area, up to five players,
and four areas to a copy.
Run.Endless makes it a run that never runs out (ziggfreed-common's DungeonEndless): one run per visit,
its reach the difficulty. The script's four band slots take turns, BandWaves (2) waves each, every
BossEvery-th wave (5, 10, 15 and on) is the Voidtaken Horseman, and once every band has had its turn the
waves come again one size bigger, up to Sizes.Max (three rises at once). Ramp makes each wave tougher:
8% more health and 4% more damage a wave on its creatures, and the Horseman a quarter more health and a
tenth more damage each time he returns, both held to Max (four times the first wave). The run lasts until
every member is down at once or everyone has left. A breather between waves (the script's Breather) lets
the party walk out the way they came in.
Chest is what each cleared wave banks for every member standing in the graveyard:
Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Wave for a wave of the dead, Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Boss_Wave for a
Voidtaken wave. A member who leaves collects theirs on the Claims tab as they go; the rest find theirs in
a chest where they came in once the run ends. Rewards.Diminish counts each run once a day: the first run
each day pays in full, later ones half, the halving reaching every banked roll. Nothing in Complete
clears an endless run, so it names none, and its best wave goes on Records' Endless Runs tab
(ziggfreed-common's Dungeon_Best_Wave), which the restless graveyard's achievements read.
EntryCost is the price of going in: Count bone fragments (Ingredient_Bone_Fragment, which skeletons
drop), burned at the gate by whoever opens an area for their party; partymates who follow walk in free.
Confirm is left out, so it is on: the player opening the area first sees CommonLib's confirm screen with
the graveyard's name and description, the fragments, how many they hold and how many it takes, and a
button whose words are ConfirmKey's; closing the screen spends nothing, and with too few the HintKey line
says where to find them. Keys lets an Eternal Candle (Hallows_Eve_Eternal_Candle) open the gate without
being spent, as it opens the Horseman's graveyard. Change Count to change the price, and the
Gravekeeper's way-in label, which shows it, with it. Text names it in the reader's language
(seasonsoforbis.lang), and its GoalKey is the line each player reads as they arrive.
